note: Parses the 25-byte uSWID header from attacker-controlled input; validates magic GUID 0x53424F4DD6BA2EACA3E67A52AAEE3BAF, hdrver, hdrsz, payloadsz, flags, compression.

code: payload = fu_input_stream_read_bytes(stream, offset + hdrsz, payloadsz, error);
note: Reads the CBOR payload bytes (payloadsz bytes) from the input stream; this payload is the attacker-controlled coSWID CBOR document.
Passes the CBOR payload to FuCoswidFirmware::parse, which decodes the CBOR map and dispatches to per-tag handlers.
Iterates over the top-level CBOR map entries; when tag ID 2 (Entity) is found, calls fu_coswid_firmware_parse_entity with the entity map value.
For each single-uint Role tag (ID 32) inside the entity map, writes to entity->roles[entity_role_cnt++] with NO bounds check on entity_role_cnt; roles[] is a fixed 6-element array.
With 7 or more single-uint Role tags, entity_role_cnt exceeds 6 and the write goes past the end of the roles[6] array, causing a heap-buffer-overflow WRITE of 4 bytes.
The counter is incremented without any upper-bound check; the 7th write (index 6) is out-of-bounds and triggers the ASan heap-buffer-overflow.
